register.labelZh: FALL 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: fall back、fall behind 和 fall over 可以描述不同形式的移動;fall down 和 fall in 則能分辨向地面倒塌和向內塌陷。；fall through 可以描述未能實現的計劃;fall to 可以指出責任落在誰身上;fall back on 則表示原有方法失敗時所依靠的人或資源。；fall off 可以表示數量下降或物件脫落;fall away 描述物料從表面剝落;fall out 則常用於頭髮或牙齒脫落。；fall about 描述大笑不止;fall for 描述上當受騙;fall in with somebody 則可以表示與某個群體為伍。；fall into 描述進入某種狀態;fall in with something 表示同意某項計劃;fall under 則指出某事物所屬的類別或規則。
register.summaryEn: collapse Fall back, fall behind and fall over describe different kinds of movement. Fall down and fall in help you distinguish between something collapsing to the ground and something collapsing inward. Fall through describes a plan that does not happen. Fall to shows who receives a duty, while fall back on describes the person or resource used when another plan fails. out Fall off can describe a decrease or something becoming detached. Fall away describes material breaking away from a surface, while fall out is commonly used for hair or teeth. Fall about describes uncontrollable laughter. Fall for describes being deceived, while fall in with somebody can describe joining or becoming friendly with a particular group. Fall into describes entering a state, fall in with something describes agreeing to a plan, and fall under shows the category or rule to which something belongs.

fixedVariable.variableZh: 保留原句中的人物、事物、時間和意思。；相近的表達可以有不同意思。例如,fall off 可以表示「下降」,也可以表示「脫落」。fall in 和 falldown 都可以描述倒塌,但方式不同。；on 和 upon 有時可以表達相同意思;with 和 in 亦會按參考表所示的形式使用。
fixedVariable.variableEn: Keep the same people, things, time and meaning. Similar expressions may have different meanings. For example, fall off can mean “decrease” or “become detached”. Fall in and fall down both describe collapse, but in different ways. On and upon can sometimes express the same meaning. With and in are both used in the forms shown in the reference bank.

benefits.titleZh: 描述移動、意外和不同形式的倒塌
benefits.titleEn: Describe movement, accidents and different kinds of
benefits.zh: fall back、fall behind 和 fall over 可以描述不同形式的移動;fall down 和 fall in 則能分辨向地面倒塌和向內塌陷。
benefits.en: collapse Fall back, fall behind and fall over describe different kinds of movement. Fall down and fall in help you distinguish between something collapsing to the ground and something collapsing inward.

benefits.titleZh: 談論告吹的計劃、責任和後備選擇
benefits.titleEn: Talk about failed plans, duties and backup choices

benefits.en: Fall through describes a plan that does not happen. Fall to shows who receives a duty, while fall back on describes the person or resource used when another plan fails.

benefits.titleEn: Describe things decreasing, breaking away or coming
benefits.zh: fall off 可以表示數量下降或物件脫落;fall away 描述物料從表面剝落;fall out 則常用於頭髮或牙齒脫落。
benefits.en: out Fall off can describe a decrease or something becoming detached. Fall away describes material breaking away from a surface, while fall out is commonly used for hair or teeth.

benefits.titleZh: 談論反應、受騙和社交選擇
benefits.titleEn: Talk about reactions, deception and social choices
benefits.zh: fall about 描述大笑不止;fall for 描述上當受騙;fall in with somebody 則可以表示與某個群體為伍。
benefits.en: Fall about describes uncontrollable laughter. Fall for describes being deceived, while fall in with somebody can describe joining or becoming friendly with a particular group.

benefits.zh: fall into 描述進入某種狀態;fall in with something 表示同意某項計劃;fall under 則指出某事物所屬的類別或規則。
benefits.en: Fall into describes entering a state, fall in with something describes agreeing to a plan, and fall under shows the category or rule to which something belongs.
